title: SMOK PRO Starter Kit – 2ml
description:
SMOK PRO POD KIT

The expressive styling of the SMOK PRO POD KIT takes your breath away. Available in seven exquisite colors, the debut is poised to put the style of elegance to the fullest. Its long-lasting 800mAh battery delivers up to 22 watts of power, combined with a SMOK NOVO 2X REPLACEMENT POD-MESHED 0.8 OHM, producing delicate flavor and smooth vapor, perfect for MTL lovers. The all-new SMOK PRO POD KIT, a daily companion that reflects your personality with a luxurious touch. Innovation keeps changing the vaping experience.

Features

- Top-fill SMOK NOVO 2X REPLACEMENT POD [CRC], with a visible window

- Compatible with Novo/Novo 2/Novo 2X Pods

- Button-triggered/draw-activated

- Combination of two textures, sandblasting oxidation and silicone gel

Specifications
Size: 24.5*15.0*107mm
Weight: 47g
Battery Capacity: 800mAh
Resistance Range: 0.6Ω-2.5Ω
Power Range: Max 22W
Standby Current: <50uA
Input Voltage: 3.3V-4.2V
Capacity: 2ML

Package List
1 x SMOK PRO POD KIT [CRC] Device (800mAh)
2 x SMOK NOVO 2X REPLACEMENT POD [CRC]-MESHED 0.8 OHM MTL
1 x User Manual
1 x Type-C Cable
